good: Boost raises speed and drains the bar.
Crashes show smoke, sparks, and quick recovery.
HUD shows speed, boost, and takedown count.
bad: Steering appears reversed; turns repeatedly end at barriers.
Bare highway, box buildings, and sparse traffic give little speed sense.
Takedown count increases, but the rival impact and wreck are unclear.
gpt-6.1-sol-high.one_line: It runs, but the backward steering and empty box world make it feel far from Burnout.

good: HUD has all Burnout parts: takedowns, boost bar that changes color, big speed number, rival distance
Boost works: speed goes to 169 mph with spark trails
Crash and respawn are fast, with a clear CRASHED text and smoke
bad: Steering is far too sharp: almost every A or D input sends the car into the wall and shows CRASHED
World is a flat grey plane with blue box buildings, cone trees and a flat purple sky with orange rays; traffic is almost absent
The takedown is hard to see: the TAKEDOWN! text is faint, and the rival is a red car that looks the same as the player car
opus-5.5.one_line: It has a real Burnout-style HUD, but you crash into the wall every time you touch the steering, on an empty grey plane with almost no traffic.
